title: M'sila teachers' sit-in over unpaid wages
location: In front of the Education Directorate, M'sila
participants_original: Primary-school teachers; no attendance estimate reported
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. Reports identify teachers but give no attendance count. The later count of affected teachers is not a count of attendees.

start_date.summary: The Dec. 7 report calls it the Sunday gathering; the Dec. 8 roundup calls it an earlier protest.

location.summary: Teachers gathered outside the M'sila Education Directorate.

demands.summary: The gathering sought payment of overdue wages.

participants.summary: Teachers are identified but neither report counts attendees.

threshold_50.summary: The affected-worker total is not a protest attendance count.

state_response.summary: The Sunday gathering is reported dispersed by public force; abuse/beating language is attributed to participants and not independently resolved.

notes: Dec. 8 is reported as a second gathering and march, not a continuous encampment. Dispersal is reported; attribution of alleged beatings is unresolved.
open_questions: Can attendance of at least 50 on Dec. 6 be established?
Which authority dispersed it, and are beatings independently documented?

title: M'sila teachers' protest and march over wages and treatment of colleagues
location: Outside the Education Directorate, M'sila, then toward the wilaya headquarters
organizer: M'sila primary-teacher coordination and teachers affiliated with several education unions, as reported by Echorouk
participants_original: Hundreds of teachers and union members (reported qualitatively as hundreds)
threshold_50_evidence: Yes, qualitatively: the contemporary report describes hundreds attending the public protest and march, exceeding 50; no exact total is given.

start_date.summary: On Dec. 7 Echorouk announced a second protest for Tuesday; the Dec. 8 roundup reports it as held.

location.summary: Outside the M'sila Education Directorate, followed by a march to the wilaya headquarters.

organizer.summary: Reported as teachers and union members; the prior report names a primary-teacher coordination.

demands.summary: Overdue wages, an inquiry into the treatment of colleagues, higher-authority intervention and departure of the sector official.

participants.summary: Reported as hundreds; no exact total.

threshold_50.summary: Qualitative report of hundreds clearly exceeds 50; exact bounds unknown.

state_response.summary: No response to the Dec. 8 gathering is reported; fields remain unknown.

notes: Distinct from Dec. 6: described as a second protest and march. Same wage dispute, but no continuous occupation is reported.
open_questions: What response, if any, did authorities make to the Dec. 8 protest?
Was there later activity or a documented endpoint?
